comments.body: why are we not updating prev all the time ? This could have an un-desired effect of some logs not getting printed at the correct frequency

retry_closure also needs to be deleted explicitly since its a permanent closure. Otherwise it'll be a memory leak. Maybe it can be a self deleting closure instead of a permanent closure ?  Or maybe the timer needs to be cancelled and closure needs to be deleted in the destructor
This has been replaced with a mutex and a TaskHandle (to support the required cancellation before engine destruction).
As discussed, I replaced it with an AnyInvocable.
`now - prev_tsamp` is forever a small single-digit number of millis if you always update `prev` to `now`, and call this macro in a tight loop. When have you seen this working?
I've reverted this fix since it's unrelated to the PR. I'll land it separately.
